slice: NORTH-WEST outer districts — Gò Vấp, District 12 (Quận 12), Tân Phú, Hóc Môn. Kept SEPARATE from SOURCES_HCMC.json, SOURCES_HCMC_NORTH.json, SOURCES_HCMC_OUTER.json and the other HCMC source files.

outlets.name: Saigoneer
outlets.note: Leading Saigon English-language culture & food outlet. Used here for the Gò Vấp 'floating temple' travel feature and TWO Hẻm Gems features on Baby African (Nigerian), Gò Vấp.

outlets.name: VnExpress
outlets.note: Vietnam's largest online newspaper. Dedicated pieces: Phù Châu Temple ('Miếu nổi 300 tuổi'), the two Gò Vấp runway-view cafés ('Hai quán cà phê ngắm máy bay hạ cánh'), and the 38-year Hoa noodle shop on Phan Huy Ích (dedicated profile + citywide hủ tiếu round-up).

outlets.name: Dân Trí
outlets.note: Major national online newspaper; corroborating feature on the two Gò Vấp plane-spotting cafés (Phen's / Landing).

outlets.name: Kenh14 (VCCorp)
outlets.note: Major Vietnamese youth news/entertainment outlet. Dedicated report on Mê Coffee's viral (and controversial) 700-teddy-bear build in Gò Vấp. Measures/reports virality; used with a second source.

outlets.name: Viory (video news wire)
outlets.note: International short-video news wire; English clip on Gò Vấp's 700-teddy-bear café. Corroborating source only.

outlets.name: vietnam.vn (national information portal)
outlets.note: National information portal; English feature on Saigon's only Nigerian restaurant (Baby African), Gò Vấp, drawing African diners for ~20 years. Corroborates the Saigoneer Hẻm Gems coverage.

outlets.name: Công an Nhân dân (CAND Online)
outlets.note: National daily; feature on the Ngã Ba Giồng national historical site, Hóc Môn.

outlets.name: Báo Văn Hóa
outlets.note: Ministry of Culture newspaper; feature on the 18 thôn vườn trầu cultural heritage, Bà Điểm / Hóc Môn.

outlets.name: Vietnam Investment Review
outlets.note: English business daily; AEON's first Vietnam shopping-centre launch (Tân Phú Celadon).

outlets.name: AEON Vietnam (corporate newsroom)
outlets.note: Operator newsroom; opening record/specs for AEON MALL Tân Phú Celadon. Corroborating official source, never a lone recommender.

outlets.name: Wikipedia (Vietnamese)
outlets.note: Lone-authority-OK for sights with a full article: Miếu Nổi, Ngã ba Giồng, 18 thôn vườn trầu.

outlets.name: MICHELIN Guide Vietnam (Ho Chi Minh City)
outlets.note: Lone-authority-OK. Checked this pass — NO Star / Bib Gourmand / Selected restaurant is listed inside Gò Vấp, District 12, Tân Phú or Hóc Môn (the HCMC selection clusters in D1/D3/D5/D10/Bình Thạnh/Phú Nhuận). No Michelin place shipped from these four districts.
